description: The file defines a React functional component named 'Home' with hooks managing connection states, OAuth statuses, project data, and user interactions for an Atlassian integration web app. It includes logic for loading connection statuses, OAuth info, project data, and handles actions like store credentials, test connections, disconnect, and switch authentication methods.

methods.name: loadConnectionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches all connection statuses, transforms them into enhanced connection state objects, and updates the state.

methods.name: loadOAuthStatus
methods.description: Fetches OAuth authentication statuses, updates connection states with OAuth info.

methods.name: handleStoreCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials via API, updates connection state, and loads projects if connected.

methods.name: handleOAuthSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful OAuth authentication, refreshes OAuth status, and loads projects.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection (OAuth or credentials), updates state, loads projects on success.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects (revokes OAuth or deletes credentials), clears projects.

methods.name: handleSwitchAuth
methods.description: Switches preferred authentication method for a service.

methods.name: loadProjects
methods.description: Loads projects or spaces from Jira or Confluence based on selected service, updates state.

methods.name: getConnectionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the connection status ('connected', 'disconnected', etc.) for 'jira' and 'confluence'.

methods.name: getServiceStatus
methods.description: Evaluates and returns the status string for a specific service based on connection state.

methods.name: getAvailableAuthMethods
methods.description: Determines available authentication methods for a service based on current connection states.

methods.name: renderMainContent
methods.description: Renders the main UI content depending on whether a connector is selected and its connection status.
